review_artifact.root_cause: app/config.py returned os.getenv("REQUEST_TIMEOUT", 5.0) directly. When configured, os.getenv produced a string, causing app/main.py to compare a numeric elapsed value with text and raise TypeError.
review_artifact.behavior_fixed: get_request_timeout() now applies float() to the environment-derived value. Numeric timeout text becomes a floating-point number, the absent-variable default remains 5.0, elapsed values strictly above the timeout report timed_out=true, equality remains false, and malformed numeric text raises ValueError instead of silently producing misleading behavior.
